record_title: Isolated points are exactly the boundary for point-mass isotropy restriction
provenance: Sharp topological correction of a point-mass isotropy embedding for Steinberg/Kumjian--Pask algebras, with an isolated-point corner repair and a graded periodicity obstruction.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Standard Steinberg isotropy induction and open-singleton corner results are prior art and are not claimed. The main residual risk is that the elementary isolated-point criterion appears implicitly or explicitly in older Steinberg-algebra literature. No independent validation is asserted.
